note: Formats, hooks and selling habits seen on other pages. Each says where it was seen, the numbers on that day, and whether we should use it. One look is one look; the research helper adds to this on every run.

items.name: Year forecast, one reel per mulank
items.numbers: 186K, 117K and 30K views against his usual 8K
items.what: A numbered series: '2027, Mulank 1', 'Mulank 2' and so on, about a minute each, same poster cover.
items.for_us: This is our 2027 series in its plainest form. Ours adds the driver twist and animation.
items.by: Instagram scout, one look on 21 Nov

items.name: One fixed look on every cover
items.numbers: Seen on all 4 Indian pages
items.what: Each page repeats one layout: a poster, text on a picture, a desk talk, a podcast clip. You know whose reel it is before reading.
items.for_us: Pick one Tarot Talk frame for the whole series and never change it.
items.by: Instagram scout, one look on 21 Nov

items.name: A practical tip people forward
items.numbers: 33.5M views on one reel, with more shares than likes
items.what: A small 'do this' tip in under a minute. People send it to family.
items.for_us: One 'send this to someone whose number is 7' episode per number.
items.by: Instagram scout, one look on 21 Nov

items.name: Short clip tied to a dated sky event
items.numbers: 782K views in 21 seconds, against his usual 212K
items.what: A very short clip that names a date window for a planet change and says what to do in it.
items.for_us: Use our own dates: full moon, 12/12, 31 December. Say the date in the first line.
items.by: Instagram scout, one look on 21 Nov

items.name: No face: text on one picture, reading in the caption
items.numbers: Best reel is 3 seconds long: 129K against her usual 31K
items.what: The reel is only a cover. The whole reading is written in a long caption.
items.for_us: Cheap to make between animated episodes. Worth one test; the evidence is two reels.
items.by: Instagram scout, one look on 21 Nov

items.name: Born on these dates
items.numbers: 97K against her usual 31K
items.what: A list for people born on 4, 13, 22 or 31. The viewer checks if they are in it.
items.for_us: Our version is the mulank itself: 'Mulank 4 wale, yeh aapke liye'. Write our own grouping.
items.by: Instagram scout, one look on 21 Nov

items.name: Desk and microphone, one setup
items.numbers: A normal reel reaches about 197K on 378K followers
items.what: One person at a desk microphone, the same on every reel, about a minute.
items.for_us: A format for Sakshi to camera if we want a face series later. Not for the animated series.
items.by: Instagram scout, one look on 21 Nov

items.name: Pick your birth date group
items.numbers: 38K and 47K against her usual 31K: about normal
items.what: The cover asks the viewer to pick 1-10, 11-20 or 21-31.
items.for_us: Easy to make, but it did not beat her usual reels. Low priority.
items.by: Instagram scout, one look on 21 Nov

items.name: Selling by link, WhatsApp or event, not by comment keyword
items.numbers: 0 of 9 reels opened asked for a comment keyword
items.what: They sell consultations, events and reports through the bio link, WhatsApp or a phone number.
items.for_us: Our comment keyword still works for the sale, but nobody else in the field leans on it. Keep a bio link as a second door.
items.by: Instagram scout, one look on 21 Nov

items.name: A task with a day to come back
items.numbers: Her fastest reel added about 200K views in a day
items.what: The reel gives a small ritual and tells the viewer when to return. Hers also uses a 'tell no one' hook.
items.for_us: Use the task and the return date. Do not use the secrecy line.
items.by: Instagram scout, one look on 21 Nov

items.name: A named character answers the viewer
items.numbers: About her usual 306K; a new one reached 103K in a day
items.what: A two-role skit: the viewer asks, a fixed character replies.
items.for_us: Our saarthi and passenger. Steady rather than a spike.
items.by: Instagram scout, one look on 21 Nov

items.name: Opening the caption on a worry
items.numbers: 117K, with 2,828 shares
items.what: The caption starts with a worry about children, then pitches a paid event.
items.for_us: Not for us. We do not open on fear.
items.by: Instagram scout, one look on 21 Nov

items.name: Two-second flash: pause on yours
items.numbers: 510K against a usual 79.6K (6.4x); 2.4 s; 1,844 shares
items.what: A reel only two or three seconds long that flashes every sign in turn, each matched to a small picture. To find your own you must pause or let it loop.
items.for_us: Flash mulank 1 to 9, each matched to a mithai, a chai or a festival, in our own drawn style; the caption says the full list so nobody is cheated.
items.by: Outside-pages scout, one look on 21 Nov
items.review_note: A meme format from abroad; it may not carry to a Hindi audience. Test one.

items.name: One relatable line over a calm clip, seven seconds
items.numbers: costarastrology 1.3M against a usual 333.5K (3.9x), 22.5K shares; sanctuarywrld's versions sit near its usual 79.6K
items.what: A single sentence about how one group feels in one situation, set over a few seconds of quiet footage. Nothing else happens.
items.for_us: One Hinglish line per mulank over our own animated loop from the 2027 series (no stock clips of others). Cheap to make in batches of nine. Humour of this kind may not carry to a Hindi audience; test three first.
items.by: Outside-pages scout, one look on 21 Nov

items.name: One question, strangers answer on a mic
items.numbers: Top example is a paid brand trip
items.what: The team asks passers-by one question about love and cuts the answers together; the subtitle of the best answer is the cover.
items.for_us: Needs filming people outdoors. An animated version using answers followers send to a story question box is possible, grouped by mulank.
items.by: Outside-pages scout, one look on 21 Nov
items.review_note: The top example is a paid brand trip, so the numbers prove nothing.

items.name: Three-day planner card
items.numbers: 78.9K, right at the page's usual 79.6K (no lift seen)
items.what: One still card listing Friday, Saturday and Sunday, each with the sky event and one line of advice.
items.for_us: A Thursday-evening card: three days, one tarot card and one do-this line each. Made for saves; numbers abroad were ordinary, so judge it on our own saves.
items.by: Outside-pages scout, one look on 21 Nov
items.review_note: Only the cover was seen, and it showed no lift.

items.name: Tribute reel at the start of a group's month, with a part two
items.numbers: 489K against a usual 191K (2.6x); part two 198K
items.what: At the start of a sign's season, a long run of famous people of that sign, titled as that sign's 'history', with a second part promised.
items.for_us: On the 1st, 10th, 19th and 28th style dates or at month start: famous Indians of one mulank, as names and our own drawings only, birth dates checked first. No celebrity footage.
items.by: Outside-pages scout, one look on 21 Nov
items.review_note: 2.6 times usual, shares not measured, and mulank has no season.

items.name: Each group as a song
items.numbers: 168K and 288K against a usual 191K (ordinary to 1.5x)
items.what: A list reel that gives every sign one song by a popular singer.
items.for_us: Each mulank as an old Hindi film song, named in text only, with our own music underneath. A sends idea; song titles as text, never the recordings.
items.by: Outside-pages scout, one look on 21 Nov
items.review_note: Only covers were seen. A meme format that may not carry.

items.name: Cover shows half the list, hides the rest
items.numbers: pinned 43.9M against a usual 15.2K; 1.8M shares. Pinned, so the creator chose it; cause not proven
items.what: A numbered list on the cover where the first two items are named and the last two are question marks.
items.for_us: Cover: '2027 ke 4 din', two shown and two hidden, all four given inside the reel and again in the caption. Honest only if the hidden ones are really delivered.
items.by: Outside-pages scout, one look on 21 Nov
items.review_note: Rests on one pinned reel that also opens on a secrecy tease, which we do not use.

items.name: 'Secret' or 'adults only' tease to open a list
items.numbers: 43.9M (pinned); usual 15.2K
items.what: The reel opens by hinting the list is secret or not for everyone, then shows ordinary items.
items.for_us: Built on secrecy bait. Do not use.
items.by: Outside-pages scout, one look on 21 Nov

items.name: Joke about one community's surnames
items.numbers: 9.7M (pinned); usual 133.5K
items.what: A sketch whose cover says a named community's surnames are out of hand.
items.for_us: Mocks a group. Do not use, and do not make a 'mulank X log aise hote hain' joke that insults.
items.by: Outside-pages scout, one look on 21 Nov
